en.headline: SFC sets November start for retail fund code changes
en.dek: The securities watchdog will bring in a value-at-risk method for derivatives exposure and tighter liquidity rules for authorised retail funds.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission said it would implement changes to the code governing authorised retail funds from November, after publishing its consultation conclusions on Wednesday.

The revisions to the Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds introduce a value-at-risk method for managing derivative exposure, which the commission said would allow a wider range of fund strategies. Requirements for accepting management companies and feeder funds will also be streamlined.

At the same time, the SFC said liquidity-risk management and safeguards for money-market funds would be strengthened. Related changes to the codes on pooled retirement funds, MPF products, investment-linked assurance schemes and real estate investment trusts will be gazetted on 16 October and take effect on 1 November.

Existing authorised funds will generally have 12 months from the effective date to adapt. The commission said the package was meant to protect investors and align Hong Kong's framework with international standards, and that it would keep using product innovation to support the city's role as an asset-management centre.

zh.headline: 證監會零售基金守則修訂十一月生效
zh.dek: 證監會公布諮詢總結，單位信託及互惠基金守則將引入風險價值計算法管理衍生工具風險，並加強流動性及貨幣市場基金保障。
body: 證券及期貨事務監察委員會周三發表諮詢總結，並表示會落實多項措施，完善證監會認可零售基金的監管制度。有關《單位信託及互惠基金守則》的修訂定於2026年11月生效。
證監會表示，零售基金管理衍生工具風險將可採用風險價值計算法，以支持更多元的基金策略。接納管理公司及聯接基金的規定亦會精簡，讓基金經理在營運上有較大彈性。
同時，流動性風險管理及貨幣市場基金的保障會加強。集資退休基金、強積金產品、與投資有關的人壽保險計劃及房地產投資信託基金四份守則的相應修訂，將於10月16日刊憲，11月1日生效。
現有認可基金一般可由修訂生效日起獲12個月過渡期。證監會指，有關安排旨在保障投資者，並使本港框架與國際標準接軌。
